| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tiles across** `tilesX` | 8 | 1 to 64 | How many tiles the grid has from left to right. Never more than the image width. |
| **Tiles down** `tilesY` | 8 | 1 to 64 | How many tiles the grid has from top to bottom. Never more than the image height. |
| **Clip limit** `clipLimit` | 2 | 0.1 to 40 | The clip limit c of OpenCV. No histogram bin of a tile may hold more than c times the average bin count. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
